entries.clue: Classic poet opening, putting love first (4)

entries.clue: Leave a league after lower score at rugby (4,4)

entries.clue: Promotion? Gutted third team is never working for that (13)

entries.clue: Answer at 5A, not here? (13)

annotation.walkthrough: ADVERTISEMENT has four syllables, so it is a tetrasyllable; TETRASYLLABLE itself has five, so the word is not one: 'not here'.
annotation.definitionFit: A tetrasyllable is a word of four syllables, as ADVERTISEMENT is.
